title: Ready for the Future
sub: Buku pendamping Bahasa Inggris Kelas 9 SMP/MTs
intro:
📌 Capaian Pembelajaran Fase D (ringkas)
  • Membicarakan rencana, pengalaman, dan sebab-akibat dengan tata bahasa yang tepat.
  • Memahami narrative, teks fungsional pendek (label, rambu, pengumuman, iklan), dan teks tentang isu lingkungan.
  • Menceritakan kembali cerita rakyat dan menulis teks persuasif sederhana.
cando: Membicarakan rencana dan prediksi dengan will dan be going to.
Memahami dan menceritakan kembali narrative text (past continuous).
Memahami label, rambu, dan peringatan (must, mustn't, have to).

text.pron_html:
🔊 Tanda pelafalan /.../
Pada beberapa kosakata disertakan bantuan pelafalan dalam ejaan Indonesia, misalnya schedule /ské-jul/. Huruf é dibaca seperti “e” pada bebek, dan e seperti pada emas. Gunakan sebagai bantuan saja — biasakan menyimak penutur asli melalui video, podcast, atau kamus daring yang menyediakan audio.

goals: Membicarakan rencana dengan be going to dan prediksi/keputusan spontan dengan will.

sections.title: Will vs be going to
head: Use
Form
Example
rows: I**'m going to** join the robotics club next semester.
Look at those clouds! It**'s going to** rain.

sections.after: Negatif: won't (will not), I'm not going to. Tanya: Will you…? / Are you going to…?

sections.title: Read the text
paras:
My Five-Year Plan
My name is Dinda, and I am in class 9. In five years, I want to be a university student studying agriculture.
My village in Garut is famous for its vegetables, but many farmers still use old methods. I'm going to learn how to grow more food with less water and fewer chemicals.
To reach my dream, I'm going to study harder, especially Biology and English. Next year, I'm going to join the school's hydroponic club. I will also read articles about smart farming every week.
I believe young people will make Indonesian farming more modern. I'll do my best!

sections.title: Narrative text
paras:
Timun Mas
Once upon a time, there lived an old widow named Mbok Srini. She wanted a child very much. One day, a giant gave her a cucumber seed. “Plant it,” said the giant, “but when the child is seventeen, you must give her to me.” Mbok Srini agreed.

The seed grew into a big golden cucumber, and inside it there was a baby girl. Mbok Srini named her Timun Mas. She grew into a kind and beautiful girl. Mbok Srini loved her so much that she did not want to give her to the giant.

When Timun Mas was seventeen, the giant came. Mbok Srini gave Timun Mas four small bags — cucumber seeds, needles, salt, and shrimp paste — and told her to run. While the giant was chasing her, Timun Mas threw the seeds. They became a cucumber field, and the giant stopped to eat. Then she threw the needles, which turned into a bamboo forest. Next, the salt became a deep sea, but the giant swam across it.
Finally, Timun Mas threw the shrimp paste. It turned into a hot muddy swamp. The giant sank and died. Timun Mas went home, and she and Mbok Srini lived happily ever after.

sections.html:
Orientation
Pengenalan tokoh, waktu, dan tempat: Once upon a time, there lived an old widow…
Complication
Masalah muncul: sang raksasa datang untuk mengambil Timun Mas.
Resolution
Masalah terselesaikan: raksasa tenggelam di rawa lumpur.
Coda (opsional)
Pesan moral: kecerdikan dan kasih sayang dapat mengalahkan kekuatan.

goals: Menanyakan dan menceritakan pengalaman dengan present perfect tense.

sections.title: Present perfect tense
head: Pattern
Example
rows: I **have visited** Lombok. She **has won** two medals.
**Have** you ever **eaten** durian? — Yes, I have.
ever, never, already, yet, just, since, for
sections.after: Present perfect = pengalaman/hasil tanpa waktu yang pasti. Simple past = waktu jelas: I have been to Bali. vs I went to Bali in 2023.

sections.title: Talking about experiences
lines: Fikri
Have you ever joined a national competition, Mira?

Yes, I have. I joined the National Science Olympiad last year.
Ya, pernah. Aku ikut OSN tahun lalu.
Fikri
Wow! Did you win?
Wah! Kamu menang?

I won a bronze medal. Have you ever joined one?
Aku dapat medali perunggu. Kamu pernah ikut?

Not yet, but I've already registered for the English speech contest this month.

Mira
That's great! I'm sure you'll do well.
Hebat! Aku yakin kamu akan tampil bagus.

sections.title: Conditional sentences type 1
head: If-clause
Main clause
Example
rows: **If** we **plant** more trees, the air **will be** cleaner.
**If** you **don't hurry**, you **won't catch** the bus.

sections.after: Tipe 1 dipakai untuk kemungkinan yang nyata di masa depan. Unless = if … not: Unless we act now, the forest will disappear.

sections.title: Read the text
paras:
Plastic: A Big Problem in Our Seas
Indonesia produces millions of tonnes of plastic waste every year, and a lot of it ends up in rivers and the sea. Plastic does not disappear. It breaks into tiny pieces called microplastics, which fish eat. If we eat the fish, the microplastics will enter our bodies too.
Sea animals also suffer. Turtles often think plastic bags are jellyfish. If a turtle eats a plastic bag, it will get sick and may die.

The good news is that we can make a difference. If every student brings a reusable bottle, our school will use thousands fewer plastic bottles each year. If we sort our rubbish, more of it will be recycled. Small actions, done by many people, will create big changes.
